tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Real-time web search across the public internet. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets ranked by relevance. Best for current events, general knowledge, and breaking news. Costs 15 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Real-time news search across major outlets. Supports country and date-range filtering for time-sensitive queries (earnings calls, product launches, geopolitics). Costs 15 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: cited_answer
tools.description: Answer a focused question with a short, cited answer researched live across the web, news, and specialist datasets. Returns Markdown with numbered citations plus the source list. Takes about 15–60 seconds. Best when you want a grounded answer rather than raw search results. Costs 100 credit(s) per c

tools.name: extract_urls
tools.description: Extract clean readable content from URLs. Costs 2 credit(s) per URL.

tools.name: academic_search
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed and pre-print research across arXiv, PubMed, bioRxiv, and medRxiv. Best for academic literature retrieval, RAG over scientific corpora, and AI-driven research workflows. Costs 5 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: wiley_finance_search
tools.description: Search licensed Wiley finance literature — peer-reviewed finance journals and finance textbooks. Best for academic-grade financial research, literature review, and AI-driven investment and economics workflows. Costs 300 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: ap_news_search
tools.description: Search Associated Press wire news as full article text over a rolling ~30-day window, with date filters for as-of queries. Best for current-events grounding, breaking-news monitoring, and AI agents that need the full story rather than a snippet. Costs 120 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: markets_search
tools.description: Search global and US equities, cryptocurrencies, forex pairs, ETFs, mutual funds, commodities, and US market movers (top gainers/losers/most active), plus US-equity key statistics (market cap, enterprise value, P/E, PEG, price-to-sales/book). Best for price lookups, market-cap and valuation retrieva

tools.name: financials_search
tools.description: Search US public-company financial statements: balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, dividend history, and insider transactions. Best for fundamental analysis, due diligence, and AI-driven investment research workflows. Costs 200 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: sec_search
tools.description: Search SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) with full text, quarterly EPS estimates vs. actuals, and equity statistics. Name the company and form type in the query (e.g. 'Nvidia latest 10-Q'); earnings-call transcripts are not included. Best for due diligence, fundamental analysis, and AI-driven investment

tools.name: economic_search
tools.description: Search US Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED), Bureau of Labor Statistics, World Bank development indicators, IMF macro data, US federal spending (USAspending), and German labour statistics (Destatis). Best for macroeconomic research, indicator lookups, and AI-driven economic analysis. Costs 50 cre

tools.name: prediction_markets_search
tools.description: Search Polymarket and Kalshi prediction markets for live and historical contracts on politics, economics, sports, and current events. Best for crowd-forecast retrieval and AI-driven probability grounding. Costs 50 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: earnings_calendar_search
tools.description: Search US quarterly earnings history: report dates taken from SEC filings, EPS estimates vs. actuals, and reported revenue, with the source of every field. Upcoming report dates are not reliably covered. Costs 120 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: clinical_search
tools.description: Search clinical trials, FDA drug labels, and ChEMBL bioactivity. Best for medical research, drug repurposing analysis, and AI-driven clinical decision support. Costs 30 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: health_search
tools.description: Search WHO global health statistics, NIH research grants, openFDA drug adverse-event reports, and FDA drug and medical-device recalls. Best for public-health research, grant discovery, pharmacovigilance, recall monitoring, and AI-driven healthcare analytics. Costs 30 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: chemistry_search
tools.description: Search ChEMBL bioactivity data (IC50/Ki/Kd/EC50), PubChem chemical structures and properties, and Open Targets target-disease associations. Best for drug discovery, cheminformatics, and AI-driven biomedical research workflows. Costs 30 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: uk_legal_search
tools.description: Search UK case law and primary legislation. Best for legal research, compliance review, statutory interpretation, and AI-driven legal-tech applications. Costs 60 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: patents_search
tools.description: Search global patent filings by keyword, technology, or assignee. Best for prior-art search, IP landscaping, competitive intelligence, and AI-driven R&D analysis. Costs 80 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: politics_search
tools.description: Search UK Parliament debates, written questions, and member activity (Hansard). Best for civic-tech tools, legislative monitoring, policy research, and AI-driven political analysis workflows. Costs 40 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: mica_regulation_search
tools.description: Search the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulatory corpus: the Level 1 regulation, Transfer of Funds Regulation, DLT Pilot Regime, Level 2 technical standards, ESMA/EBA guidelines and Q&As, and national implementing laws across all 27 EU/EEA member states. Best for crypto compliance research a

tools.name: cybersecurity_search
tools.description: Search CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, NVD CVE records with severity scores, EPSS exploit-probability data, and MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques. Best for vulnerability triage, threat intelligence, and AI-driven security operations workflows. Costs 10 credit(s) per call.

tools.name: start_dataset_research
tools.description: Start an async research task over a specialist dataset collection: vehicle-safety (NHTSA recalls, complaints, defect investigations, VIN decoding), short-sellers (activist short reports and fund letters), or sanctions (OFAC, UN, UK HMT, Australia DFAT, Swiss SECO, US Consolidated Screening List, INT

tools.name: get_research_task
tools.description: Check a dataset research task started with start_dataset_research. Returns its status while it runs (free) and the cited answer once completed; credits are charged once, on the first call that sees it completed. Poll every few seconds.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Look up registration data for a domain name, IP address, or AS number via RDAP (the successor to WHOIS). Returns registrar, nameservers, DNSSEC status, creation/expiry dates, status codes, and any published contacts. Use for domain due diligence, expiry monitoring, abuse-contact discovery, and IP/AS

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a legal entity through the GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier registry. Look up a known LEI code, or search by legal name to find one. Returns the official legal name, registered and headquarters addresses, jurisdiction, legal form, registration status, national company-register number, and BIC c

tools.name: validate_eu_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number against VIES, the European Commission's official VAT registry. Returns whether the number is registered and, where the member state discloses it, the trader's registered name and address. Use for B2B onboarding, reverse-charge invoicing checks, and KYC. Costs 3 credit(s) pe

tools.name: scan_dependencies
tools.description: Check a list of open-source dependencies for known vulnerabilities using OSV.dev. For each package version, returns matching advisories with CVE aliases, a computed CVSS base score, severity rating, CWE ids, and the versions that fix the issue — plus a rollup by severity. Use it to audit a lockfile,
